target.statement: AUC of IForest ASD with incremental learning on the credit card fraud detection dataset (0.611)
target.dataset: Credit card Churn prediction dataset (Kaggle, 10,000 samples, 13 features)

compute.basis: No code released; the streaming protocol (PySAD, 30:70 static/stream split, incremental partial-fit for 7 models) must be reimplemented from scratch, and the exact Kaggle dataset variant and preprocessing are ambiguous, so matching the reported AUC is unlikely without significant reverse-engineering.

blockers: Incremental streaming protocol details (window size, partial-fit epochs) not given
Reported AUCs near 0.5 suggest fragile/ambiguous setup hard to replicate
title: Incremental Outlier Detection Modelling Using Streaming Analytics in Finance & Health Care
